samplingFinding: Twenty-seven of forty unseen query pages on twenty previously qualified training domains passed the frozen capture gates, a 67.5% page yield. All twenty-seven successful captures were accepted. The remaining thirteen attempts were four blocked annotations and nine navigation or capture errors.
visualValidationFinding: All twenty-seven accepted full-page annotation views were inspected after capture and showed coherent query-result evidence. The 317 frozen roots span mass, volume, count, length, and area. They include native square-foot prices; explicit case-count plus volume offers; count packs; meter, yard, and foot quantities; price ranges and starting prices; package count versus physical dimension, product diameter, and batch-capacity ambiguity; accessories and query-adjacent products; and listings where the correct outcome is abstention because sale quantity, coverage, or price binding is absent. Fixed chat and navigation elements remained below the frozen twenty-percent obstruction limit and did not cover the selected evidence.
